title: Extension by zero of abelian Zariski sheaves is exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $X_{\rm Zar}$, $U_{\rm Zar}$ the small Zariski sites of $X$ and of $U$ [def-sc-zariski-site] (the objects of $U_{\rm Zar}$ are the opens $W\subseteq U$, which are also objects of $X_{\rm Zar}$, and a family of opens of $W$ is a covering of $W$ in $U_{\rm Zar}$ if and only if it is one in $X_{\rm Zar}$). Let $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$, $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian categories of abelian sheaves on these sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $\mathcal G\in\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $\mathcal G|_U\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal G(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal G$, and for a morphism $\psi$ of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $(\psi|_U)_W=\psi_W$. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ let $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\rm Zar}$ with $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=0$ if $V\not\subseteq U$ ($V\subseteq X$ open), whose restriction map along $V'\subseteq V$ is the restriction map of $\mathcal F$ if $V\subseteq U$ (then also $V'\subseteq U$) and $0$ otherwise; a morphism $\alpha:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ gives $j_{p!}\alpha$, equal to $\alpha_V$ for $V\subseteq U$ and to $0$ otherwise. Let $\theta_{\mathcal F}:j_{p!}\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F$ be the sheafification of $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ as a presheaf of abelian groups on the site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and $j_!\alpha:j_!\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F'$ the unique morphism with $j_!\alpha\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}=\theta_{\mathcal F'}\circ j_{p!}\alpha$; $j_!\mathcal F$ is the *extension of $\mathcal F$ by zero*. Then $j_!:\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ is an exact functor of abelian categories: it is additive and carries every short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal F''\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ to a short exact sequence $0\to j_!\mathcal F'\to j_!\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F''\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]; in particular it carries monomorphisms to monomorphisms.

proof.text: Restriction to the slice is additive by its componentwise formula. Mathlib sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous and Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive therefore prove zariski_extensionByZero_additive for the specified constructed functor.

Regard Opens.grothendieckTopology X as a precoverage using toPrecoverage. Its generated Grothendieck topology is the original one: one inclusion is toGrothendieck_toPrecoverage_le, and every covering sieve S belongs to the generated topology since Sieve.generate S.arrows = S. The precoverage has isomorphisms, composition and base-change stability, and has pullbacks since Opens X has pullbacks. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-exact] to this precoverage and U, then rewrite the topology equality. This gives preservation of every short exact sequence by exactly the functor in the statement.

For a monomorphism f form ShortComplex.cokernelSequence f. It is exact by ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact, its first arrow is f and hence monic, and its final arrow is epic. Thus it is short exact by [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel] (c). Apply the preceding short-exactness preservation and take ShortExact.mono_f to obtain that the image of f is monic.
